turns.question: What was the total ad spend on days when the email campaign had no booked lead, from 17 August to 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for ad spend on days without a booked lead, so I cannot give that figure. The closest metrics are Ad spend (EUR), which can be grouped by day and filtered to the email channel, and Bookings, which can be grouped by day and filtered to the email channel; the layer does not combine them into the figure you asked for, and no freshness statement applies because I ran no query.
